CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

We’re building a modern enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake and need a BI Analyst who works directly with the business to turn data into decisions. You’ll partner with stakeholders to scope their reporting needs, build dashboards, and teach teams how to use them. This role is as much about relationships and enablement as it is about building.

What You'll Do:
Partner with stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations to understand their goals and translate them into clear requirements and KPIs

Scope dashboard projects: define success criteria, prioritize requests, set timelines, and manage expectations

Build, publish, and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI (or Tableau) that are accurate , intuitive, and actionable

Write SQL against Snowflake to explore data, validate results, and support ad hoc analysis

Work with Data Engineering to shape the semantic layer and data models, define KPI and calculation logic, flag data quality issues, and improve report performance and Snowflake costs

Build the business definitions and synonyms that help AI tools (like Snowflake Cortex Analyst or Power BI Copilot) answer questions correctly

Test AI-generated reports and text-to-SQL results against known-correct answers before they go live

Run training sessions, workshops, and office hours that build self-service skills across the business

Create user guides, metric definitions, and walkthroughs so business users can trust and navigate the data

Gather feedback after launch, track adoption, and iterate on dashboards

What You'll Bring:
5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, FP&A, or a similar role

Strong dashboarding skills in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool

Working SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, CTEs, basic window functions)

Demonstrated ability to run requirements-gathering conversations and turn vague asks into scoped deliverables

Hands-on use of AI tools in analytical work, with the judgment to evaluate output quality and spot unsupported answers.

Experience facilitating trainings , workshops, or demos for non-technical audiences

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain data clearly

Strong attention to detail and a habit of validating numbers before sharing them

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse

Familiarity with DAX and dimensional modeling concepts

Experience writing business definitions, synonyms, or test cases for AI-driven or natural-language analytics tools.

Background in finance, FP&A, or sales operations

Exposure to dbt , Fivetran , or modern data stack tools

Experience building a data community or champions program

Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Business, IT, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

**Overview**  
  

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Industry and Security Analysis Group (ISAG) within JOID provides analytical, technical, and program support to promote, grow, and protect the U.S. industrial base. ISAG’s support spans the Department of Defense (DOD), Department of Commerce, and other agencies to deliver critical decision support to national security leaders. Our team informs policy decisions, enables execution of comprehensive strategies and monitors and reports on the effectiveness of implementation. This enables senior leaders to execute strategies for developing and sustaining a robust industrial base that meets our nation’s strategic resource objectives. From policy to practice, we are a team of economic and national security professionals providing innovative solutions for our Nation’s most pressing security challenges.

We have immediate need for a Business Intelligence Analyst to provide onsite support at the Mark Center in Alexandria, VA.

  
**Responsibilities**  
  

The Business Intelligence Analyst will support the Global Investment and Economic Security mission to protect U.S. national security interests and Defense Industrial Base (DIB) equities from adversarial capital, foreign influence, and strategic risk exposure. The analyst will conduct Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) and economic security due diligence assessments of risk associated with foreign investment, corporate ownership structures, and industrial base dependencies. The analyst will conduct business intelligence, economic, and threat analysis to develop analytic products. The analyst will integrate subject matter expertise and market analysis, leveraging business intelligence tools to connect large, diverse data sources from government, commercial, and open sources. The analyst will research and assess foreign companies’ business operations and foreign investment activity that may present national security considerations for the Department of War and collaborate across relevant offices within the Department.

  
**Qualifications**  
  

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, National Security, Intelligence, or related field
* 3+ years of relevant experience conducting economic security, financial analysis, business intelligence, counterintelligence, national security, defense industry, or risk analysis
* Experience analyzing corporate structures, ownership, investment activity, or industrial base dynamics
* Ability to research complex economic topics and develop on short notice concise, informative products for senior leaders
* Active TS/SCI clearance
* Able to work fully onsite based on client needs

**Desired:**

* Master's degree in Business, Finance, or Economics
* Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) or Specialist Certificate in Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CFT)
* Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), or Certified in Financial or Forensics (CFF)
* Military Intelligence experience

  
**Pay Range Information**  
  
At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Virginia, Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $110,000.00/Yr. - USD $140,000.00/Yr.
